# Workflow document reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo test -p sagat-tests --test contract_developer_experience`; SAGAT_DOCS_BLESS=1 rewrites it. Do not edit. -->

Made from `specs/001-platform-foundation/contracts/workflow.schema.json`. A workflow is one JSON (or YAML) object: this page lists its fields and the fields of each kind of node. The schema checks the shape; the platform's codec checks more (the graph, the expressions, the references between nodes), and `sagat workflow validate` runs the codec: [errors.md](../quickstarts/errors.md) says what each of its findings means. Some shapes are reserved for capabilities still under development; schema acceptance alone does not make a node runnable. See the [capability validation report](../../specs/014-workflow-primitives/validation-report.md).

## The document

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiVersion` | `"sagat-octopus-orchestrator.io/v1"` | yes |  |
| `bodies` | object |  |  |
| `chainPolicy` | [`chainPolicy`](#chainPolicy) |  |  |
| `entrypoint` | string (min length 1) | yes |  |
| `inputSchema` | object |  |  |
| `kind` | `"Workflow"` | yes |  |
| `limits` | [`limits`](#limits) |  |  |
| `metadata` | object | yes |  |
| `metadata.description` | string |  |  |
| `metadata.labels` | object |  |  |
| `metadata.name` | string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,63}$`) | yes |  |
| `nodes` | array of `node` (min items 1, max items 10000) | yes |  |
| `outputSchema` | object |  |  |
| `state` | [`state`](#state) |  |  |
| `triggers` | array of object |  |  |
| `triggers[].connector` | string |  | Required for a message trigger: the slug of the connector that consumes the messages. |
| `triggers[].cron` | string |  | Required for a cron trigger: five fields, minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. |
| `triggers[].endpoint` | string |  | Required for a webhook trigger: the slug of the endpoint that receives the events. |
| `triggers[].eventType` | string |  | Required for an event trigger; for a webhook or message trigger it narrows the events that start a run. |
| `triggers[].filter` | string |  | A side-effect-free condition over `event` (id, source, type, subject, correlationKey, occurredAt, receivedAt) and `data`; the event starts a run only when it holds. |
| `triggers[].kind` | one of `"manual"`, `"event"`, `"webhook"`, `"message"`, `"cron"` | yes | manual: somebody starts it. event: an event of a type, from any source. webhook: an event received by a webhook endpoint of the namespace. message: an event consumed from a topic or queue by a connector of the namespace. cron: a schedule. |
| `triggers[].source` | string |  | For an event trigger: only events published by this source (an endpoint or connector slug, or `api`). |
| `triggers[].timezone` | string |  | IANA name of the time zone of a cron trigger (UTC when absent). |

## Nodes

Every node has the fields below; each kind adds its own. The kinds: [`activity`](#activity), [`timer`](#timer), [`waitEvent`](#waitEvent), [`condition`](#condition), [`parallel`](#parallel), [`child`](#child), [`saga`](#saga), [`script`](#script), [`foreach`](#foreach), [`humanApproval`](#humanApproval), [`end`](#end), [`forEach`](#forEach), [`while`](#while), [`repeatUntil`](#repeatUntil), [`approval`](#approval), [`switch`](#switch), [`continueAsNew`](#continueAsNew).

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string (min length 1) | yes |  |
| `next` | string |  |  |
| `onError` | string |  |  |
| `timeoutMs` | integer (min 1) |  |  |
| `type` | string | yes |  |

### activity

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `activity` | string | yes |  |
| `compensateWith` | string |  | The activity that undoes this one. It runs when a saga around this node compensates, or, for a step in the body of a collection or loop, when that scope stops (a failed iteration, a cancellation) with iterations that completed: inside one iteration in reverse dependency order, between collection iterations in no order, and across loop iterations last iteration first. It must be idempotent and tolerate an effect that never happened. |
| `compensationRetry` | [`retry`](#retry) |  | The retry budget of the compensation (compensateWith). Five attempts, exponential from two seconds to five minutes, with jitter when absent. |
| `compensationTimeoutMs` | integer (min 1) |  | Longest one attempt of the compensation may take. |
| `highRisk` | boolean |  | An attempt whose outcome is unknown (lease lost, timeout, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN) is never retried or compensated blindly: it is reconciled when reconcileWith says how, and otherwise waits for an operator. |
| `idempotencyTemplate` | string |  |  |
| `irreversible` | boolean |  | The effect cannot be undone once it has happened. A saga, or the collection or loop that owns the body, that has to compensate past it ends PARTIAL. Cannot be combined with compensateWith. |
| `reconcileWith` | string |  | The activity that finds out whether this one happened, after an attempt with an unknown outcome. It answers {"effect": "applied"\|"not_applied"\|"unknown"} and, for applied, optionally {"output": ...}. |
| `retry` | [`retry`](#retry) |  |  |
| `secrets` | array of string (max items 16) |  | Names of the secrets of the namespace the worker may ask for while it holds a lease on this step. Names only: a value is never part of a definition. |
| `type` | `"activity"` | yes |  |

### child

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cancelPolicy` | one of `"propagate"`, `"detach"`, `"request_cancel"` |  | What happens to the child when the parent is stopped. propagate (default): the child is cancelled and the parent does not wait for it. request_cancel: the child is cancelled and the parent waits until it has settled. detach: the child keeps running. |
| `input` | string |  | Expression over the parent's data that must evaluate to a JSON object (for example input.order or steps.charge.output); the parent's own input when absent. |
| `type` | `"child"` | yes |  |
| `version` | integer (min 1) |  | Pins a published version number; the workflow's active version when absent. |
| `workflowId` | string | yes | Name of the workflow to start, resolved in the namespace of the parent run when the child starts. |

### saga

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `begin` | string | yes | The first node of the saga. Everything reachable from it is the body of the saga; the body is entered only from here and holds no end node. When it completes, control goes to next. |
| `cancelPolicy` | one of `"compensate_completed"`, `"abort_no_compensation"`, `"wait_in_flight_then_compensate"` |  | What a cancellation or a deadline does to the saga. compensate_completed (default): stop what is in flight and compensate what completed. wait_in_flight_then_compensate: let the attempts in flight finish, then compensate everything that completed. abort_no_compensation: stop and compensate nothing. |
| `onCompensationFailure` | one of `"manual_review"`, `"fail"` |  | manual_review (default): a compensation that fails after its retries waits for an operator. fail: the saga ends COMPENSATION_FAILED. |
| `type` | `"saga"` | yes |  |
